text: Requesting that delegated Item SC25.13 be re-opened with respect to Recommendation 6 only and that Recommendation 6 of Item SC25.13 be deleted and replaced with a new Recommendation 6.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Re-opened Delegated Item SC25.13, entitled "Standing Prohibitions - Upton Road" with respect to Recommendation 6 only. 2. Deleted Recommendation 6 of Delegated Item SC25.13 and replaced it with the following new Recommendation 6: "6. Prohibit standing at all times on the south side of Upton Road, between the east end of Upton Road and a point 82 metres west.".
